fusions.name: Edict from Above
fusions.desc: Sends a decree of shadow into the first enemy it meets that deals 28 damage and ignores its resistances.

fusions.name: Command Shriek
fusions.desc: A shriek across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Rally Cry
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
